title: Ironwood Field Operations Radio Relay
brief: A dispatcher’s radio relay for a municipal water-main repair, drafted from the supervisor’s work order and crew status update.

slip.document:
# Ironwood Field Operations Radio Relay
04/18/2026 | Dispatch desk: Colleen Fitzgerald | Channel 3

## Source information
Supervisor Dmitri Brennan's work order, received at 07:12, authorizes a leak isolation and repair at the 8-inch water main near 214 Mill Street and Oak Avenue. The work order identifies the affected valve as V-14 and gives a target completion time of 10:30. Crew lead Ethan Petrov reported at 07:18 that the crew was staged at the Ironwood yard, 12 minutes from the site. The valve vault is a confined space; the work order requires atmospheric testing and ventilation before entry.

## Radio relay
At 07:20, I relayed the assignment to Petrov on Channel 3: "Proceed to 214 Mill Street at Oak Avenue for the leak repair. Isolate valve V-41 at the site." The relayed entry instruction was: "Enter the vault and repair the 8-inch main." I also gave the target completion time of 10:30.

Petrov replied that the crew would leave the yard at 07:25. Based on the 12-minute travel estimate, the crew should arrive at 07:37. I told Brennan the crew would meet the 07:30 site-arrival deadline.

At 07:22, Brennan confirmed that water service to the two listed properties could be interrupted during the repair. I relayed that notice to Petrov and instructed him to notify occupants before shutting off service.

## Follow-up
Petrov acknowledged the assignment and repeated the street, intersection, and target completion time. Dispatch will keep Channel 3 open for updates and log the crew's arrival and service-restoration times. Brennan remains the work-order contact for scope changes or additional parts requests.

errors.quote: Isolate valve V-41 at the site
errors.explanation: The source work order identifies the affected valve as V-14, not V-41. The relay must preserve the work-order valve number.
errors.fix: Isolate valve V-14 at the site

errors.quote: Enter the vault and repair the 8-inch main
errors.explanation: The work order requires atmospheric testing and ventilation before confined-space entry, but neither step is included in this relayed entry instruction.
errors.fix: Test the atmosphere and ventilate before entering the vault to repair the 8-inch main

errors.quote: the crew would meet the 07:30 site-arrival deadline
errors.explanation: The crew leaves at 07:25 and the stated travel time is 12 minutes, making arrival 07:37, seven minutes after the deadline. It cannot meet the 07:30 deadline.
errors.fix: the crew would miss the 07:30 site-arrival deadline
